confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable; hostel and budget-hotel anchors vary widely by area. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship (about 2.5x and 2.2x the beer anchor) because direct bar-price knowledge is limited. July is monsoon season, but Colombo city hotels are mostly business-driven, so no off-season discount was applied. Accommodation assumes usual service charges and taxes are included. The FX figure is from RBA-domain search results (two searches agreed); the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: South Asian tourist-city basis: budget meals and dorm beds benchmarked against Kathmandu-level pricing, mid-range hotel rooms against Indian metro tourist hotels, then adjusted upward for Colombo's higher alcohol taxes and hotel service and tax layers. No specific listings or city-price pages were consulted.
